parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client and make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: DataCacheId
parameters.description: The ID of the data cache.

parameters.name: DestinationRegionId
parameters.description: The destination region to which you want to copy the data cache.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data cache.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path of the data cache.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the existing data cache is located.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group to which the data cache belongs.

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description: The number of days to retain the data cache.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the data cache.
